utterance: Two outlets report a fire at Acme Alloys - does it touch our network?

docs.title: Screened article: Acme fire
docs.text: A major fire broke out overnight at the Acme Alloys GmbH plant in Graz, interrupting alloy compound production. Firefighters contained the blaze by early morning, the company said.

docs.title: Wire: Fire at Acme Alloys facility
docs.text: Fire at Acme Alloys GmbH facility disrupts alloy output. The company said a damage assessment is under way at its Graz site and gave no restart date.
